create_Sampler: create a Sampler module with configurable sampler_x and async_fan_out parameters for Gumbel-softmax token sampling
run_Sampler_forward: run the Sampler forward pass on logits and temperatures tensor to sample tokens with optional Gumbel-softmax rescaling
test_Sampler_greedy_path: test the Sampler zero-temperature fast path that returns greedy argmax tokens without sampling
test_Sampler_tree_rescaling: test the Sampler with is_tree enabled to apply sampler_x rescaling via async_spec_helpers
run_profile_sampler: run the profile_sampler function to benchmark Sampler throughput on batch and vocab sized tensors
